title: Halo Dental hero
description: A full-screen black stage panel inset by a thin margin with 8px corners, a product photo or video behind. A giant white wordmark fills the bottom-left corner and a 64px tagline sits on the right; on phones the tagline rests at the bottom above an orange play button.
notes: pass the photo or video through media; the default is a soft light on black
the panel always uses the theme's dark palette; pair it with halodental-opus-header (overlay)
